name: – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Dr Ahmadreza Djalali in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Dr Ahmadreza Djalali, a Swedish-Iranian doctor held in Iran since 2016 and sentenced to death after what the Parliament calls an unfair trial. It asks Iran to free him and all political prisoners, stop executions, and give him medical care and a lawyer. It also asks European countries to push harder for EU citizens held in Iran and to consider new sanctions. The text is a statement of demands, not a law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament demands Djalali's release, medical care and a halt to executions.
- **Who it affects:** Djalali, other prisoners in Iran, and EU citizens held there.
- **What happens next:** EU countries and the EU's foreign service are urged to raise his case and consider sanctions.
